scope: Isolated offline private bundle build, install, activation/export/recovery rehearsal; not provisioning or scientific acceptance

manifestContains: All sixteen exact catalog manifests and version/hash selections
All 13456 member IDs and full annual member-series SHA256 identities
Every payload file path, byte count, SHA256 and restrictive mode
Exact source snapshots with hashes, checked against authorized local source before install/activation/export
recovery: Install does not activate and never replaces an existing release
Verified immutable staged files are fsynced and renamed into a content-addressed release
Activation uses an exclusive operator lock, exact expected-active precondition, immutable recovery receipt and atomic pointer rename
Prior release bytes remain untouched; interrupted staging directories cannot be selected as releases
Recovery to the initial unconfigured state becomes explicit 503 withholding, never legacy file fallback
Abandoned lock removal requires its exact trusted hash and a proven-dead PID; live-owner lock removal refuses
Private export reconstructs byte-identical trusted archive and never replaces an existing output
negativeCases: Bundle path traversal, symlink components and duplicate/nonregular paths
Wrong external bundle hash, missing archive, corrupt/truncated payload
Unknown bundle version or catalog/member identity mismatch
Self-attested modified source with recomputed internal hash still refuses against local authorized source
Wrong activation precondition and live lock refusal
Missing or corrupt installed member ensemble causes explicit runtime 503

Subsequent bundle manifests included all complete catalog manifests explicitly.

operatorContract.expectedActiveMeaning: The exact previously active release SHA256, or none. No implicit activation or overwrite.
operatorContract.trustBoundary: The expected bundle SHA256 is delivered independently by the authorized parent/operator; it is never inferred as trust from untrusted package contents.
operatorContract.runtimeFlagValue: Absolute path to the privately installed store, not an artifact path supplied through HTTP
operatorContract.unsetRuntimeFlag: Original generated-artifacts layout remains the default
operatorContract.brokenConfiguredRoot: Fails closed, without falling back to original files
operatorContract.sourceProtection: Any change to one of the thirteen protected source/protocol files requires rebuilding and reauthorizing a new bundle SHA256.
operatorContract.ownership: Parent owns actual authorized transport, provisioning, runtime flag changes and any deployment; none was performed here.
operatorContract.concurrencyBoundary: Private directories must not be concurrently writable by an untrusted same-UID process; the operator lock serializes supported offline changes.
operatorContract.authorizationBoundary: No authenticated Railway CLI session, SSH agent/key, bucket or mounted volume is established by this work. An authorized operator must use the official Railway SSH/SFTP instructions and supply their own service target and approved credentials; none are fabricated or inferred.
exactCurrentBundleCommandPrerequisites: Operator is in the exact authorized source checkout matching the thirteen protected source snapshots; node dependencies/tsx are available.
Operator has already transferred the CURRENT exact private bundle to the named 0600 file using their authorized SSH/SFTP path; this work performs no connection or transfer.
The printed sha256sum must match the separately trusted current bundle SHA256 and byte length 103204794 before proceeding.
Use the exact existing release SHA256 instead of none if activation is replacing an existing active release; never bypass the precondition.
Record the activation receipt SHA256 from actual command output; the rehearsal receipt is not a deployed recovery receipt.
ephemeralRecovery: Without a mounted persistent volume, a new deployment/container can lose the entire installed store, active pointer, bundle and on-container recovery receipts.

Retain the authorized exact bundle, trusted SHA256 and actual activation receipt privately outside the ephemeral container using operator-approved storage; this work creates no bucket, volume or other service.

After an ephemeral loss, reinstall the exact bundle into the new matching source checkout, reactivate with expected-active=none, and reapply FAIR_ARTIFACT_ROOT through the parent-authorized runtime configuration procedure.
A lost store must produce explicit 503 artifact refusal until reinstallation. No fallback, public Git inclusion, public upload endpoint or scientific promotion is an acceptable recovery method.
If the deployed source changes, rebuild and reauthorize a new bundle instead of silently reusing a superseded source-bound bundle.

actualProjectCompiler.fix: Array.from(parts.entries()) avoids TS2802 under the existing project target without changing tsconfig, runtime semantics or gates

remaining: Actual authorized transport/storage provisioning and deployed artifact availability remain parent-owned and unperformed.
All existing scientific negative gates, unapproved histories/controls and legacy production engine withholding remain unchanged.
